statement: PLINDER provides over 400k protein–ligand systems, extensive protein/pocket/ligand similarity annotations, linked apo and predicted structures, and test stratification by novel ligand, pocket, protein or all, explicitly designed to reduce information leakage and support realistic evaluation.
locator: Official PLINDER repository and documentation, accessed 2026-10-07
notes: Attractive OOD infrastructure; the current release documents a BindingDB affinity parsing issue, so affinity usage needs care.
